WITH tool_metrics AS (
    SELECT effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
           AVG(toolwearpct) AS avg_tool_usage_severity,
           SUM(toolwearpct) AS total_tool_wear
    FROM performance_and_safety
    GROUP BY effectivenessrobot
), operation_metrics AS (
    SELECT operbotdetref AS robot_id,
           SUM(progcyclecount) AS tpc,
           AVG(cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time_seconds
    FROM operation
    GROUP BY operbotdetref
), metrics AS (
    SELECT r.botdetreg AS robot_id, t.avg_tool_usage_severity,
           t.total_tool_wear / NULLIF(o.tpc, 0) AS twr,
           o.tpc, o.avg_cycle_time_seconds
    FROM robot_details r
    LEFT JOIN tool_metrics t ON t.robot_id = r.botdetreg
    LEFT JOIN operation_metrics o ON o.robot_id = r.botdetreg
)
SELECT robot_id, avg_tool_usage_severity, twr, tpc, avg_cycle_time_seconds,
       CASE WHEN twr > 0.001 AND tpc > 10000 THEN 'URGENT'
            WHEN twr > 0.0005 OR avg_tool_usage_severity > 75 THEN 'WARNING'
            ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS tool_status
FROM metrics
ORDER BY twr DESC NULLS LAST, tpc DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;
